review_type: AI source review and synthetic software regression checks; not a human or field usability study

original_finding.scope: A rejected superseded input prediction could display an error over a newer case, and its finally block could enable the newer loading case control.
original_finding.source_resolution: Request ownership is checked for resolved and rejected predictions; error display and control release require the originating case version to remain current and no pending case load.

new_test_names: A rejected old input prediction cannot display its error over a newer loaded case
An old prediction finally cannot release the button owned by a newer pending case load
A current input prediction rejection remains visible and releases its own button
A successful old input prediction cannot overwrite a newer loaded case
